data.budget: read-only survey, no worktree, no tests run
data.claim: No to both. It is five separable deliverables, it rests on layers and a field type that do not exist, it needs undecided design answers, and SE-packs stays blocked after it lands because B-org-bundle and B-org-layers are open.
data.falsifier: An existing org or local layer in the overlay loader or Config.load, an object field type in FIELD_TYPES, a decision record settling template storage, or SE-packs having no open need besides SE-workflow-template.
data.mechanism: Missing: (a) org layer and conf.d: CE-defaults-file -> CE-layer-stack -> CE-confd-loader / B-org-layers -> B-org-bundle are all open, no 'conf.d' in ddflow/*.py, services/overlay.py resolves only config/project/builtin, with no local or org, and the item has no edge to any of them. (b) FIELD_TYPES is string, integer, boolean, array of strings, so a nested stage list cannot be a record field; kinddata refuses code keys, so a data kind has no behavioural validator. Undecided: Q1 source of truth: log record (r-log-is-the-state), overlay files, or conf.d fragments plus a record kind (docs/ddflow/research/config-internal.md, a research line, no decision). Q2 land with the org seam empty, or wait for B-org-layers. Q3 generator: derive kind_pipelines at load, or write config.changed, and who wins against a hand-set [gates].kind_pipelines. Q4 verb home: `ddflow workflow` is taken by state/pipeline/gate/drop; `workflow template <verb>` or `workflow <name> <verb>` (B-rw-workflow text). Title order is stale: D-config-layer-order supersedes it and adds user, env, CLI, session and enforced layers. PROPOSED SPLIT: .1 format: pure parser and validator with file:line, core only, no dependency. .2 record kind: template as a record under RC1-RC12, after Q1 and the field-type answer. .3 layered loader on OverlayLoader with provenance, after Q1/Q2. .4 generator: stages to kind_pipelines and plan skeleton, after Q3. .5 verbs show/edit/reset/diff/explain on CLI and MCP, knobs, upgrade fragments and docs, after Q4. Plus one org-layer task needing B-org-layers. Only .1 can start now. Critical path for SE-packs and CP-kits is CE-defaults-file (no needs).

data.question: Can SE-workflow-template land as one item on today's main, and does landing it unblock SE-packs and CP-kits?

data.summary: `ddflow next` reports ready work as held by the cap with 14 of 20 in flight and 6 slots free, because the slots are offered to higher-ranked items; 5 of the 6 named (B-export-security-md, fix-B5dc280b4eb, fix-B8efd3d1bc4, ADP-fs, dx-gitleaks-revoked-key-regression) are listed INTERRUPTED in the same output, with no live lease. CE-defaults-file, the root of the layer chain, and SE-workflow-template are reported held behind them.
data.title: next offers free parallelism slots to INTERRUPTED items nobody is running

data.summary: `ddflow_brief item=SE-workflow-template check_recovery=true` spent its 1200 tokens on the recovery list and the rule titles, so Current, Ready now, decisions and Operational memory came back as headers with only a 'more cut' line, and no lessons appeared. The brief is meant to replace reading lessons, yet the focused item got no ranked lessons or decisions at all.

data.summary: `ddflow decision applicable SE-workflow-template` lists only D-restart-window-2026-10-24, a project-wide decision whose window closed on 2026-10-24, and omits D-shared-engines-r2 (governs ddflow/**, names this engine) and D-config-layer-order (names workflow templates). An item with no globs matches nothing by path, and an output with one stale row reads as a complete answer rather than saying the check could not run.
data.title: decision applicable misses governing decisions for an item with no globs
